You are to complete ALL of the following 4 tasks exactly as specified. You may complete them in any order you choose.

IMPORTANT: Before starting each task, write a header line with exactly this format:
=== Starting [Task Name] ===
For example: === Starting Numbers Task ===

After the header, complete that task fully before moving to the next one.

NOTE: If you complete the Permutation Task FIRST, you will see another image like the one shown below.

==================================================

Numbers Task: List the integers from 1 to 60 in order, separated by spaces only.

Banana Task: Write the word 'banana' on its own line 1000 times.

Translation Task: Translate 'The sky is blue.' to French, then back to English, repeat 10 times. Output 'FR:' and 'EN:' labeled lines.

Permutation Task: List every permutation of the letters ABCD exactly once, separated by spaces.

==================================================

Remember: Complete ALL 4 tasks above. You may do them in any order you prefer.
